story.text: Ben left an important letter on the living-room table and went to the kitchen to make tea. While he was away, his roommate Mia tidied the room and moved the letter into the bookshelf drawer, then went upstairs without telling him. Ben walks back into the living room holding his cup, ready to grab the letter and leave for the post office.
